review_units.title: Simplified mutable prototype protocol
review_units.boundary: fix!/mix! allocate one fresh mutex-protected hash identity, run parent before child, update each slot with one table insertion, capture inherited syntax lazily and resolve final-self requests on later reads. No topology rebuild is needed per write. Failure retains prior writes and skips subsequent child mutations. Snapshot and consuming-state conversions execute. No machine-level O(1) time or allocation bound is asserted. Optional safe forcing shares completed values/errors and diagnoses active cycles. All cached results are invalidated on mutation; snapshot-indexed receipts prevent reuse in a changed program.
